notes.title: Fall Up time-limited demo available during the Chinese New Year Steam Event!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

We are excited to announce that Fall Up is participating the 'Chinese New Year Event'.

During the event period, we will release a time-limited demo from Feb-7 to Feb-14, which will feature a few stages at very begining of the game. And there will be 2 modes for each stage:

1. Exploration - Try to find all the collections, 'Battery' and 'Gems' in the stages.

2. Speed Run - After obtained all the collections, the speed run mode will be unlocked, which need you pass through the stages in a limit of time.

Hop you enjoy this demo, and Happy New Year!
